hero.title: We bring deep water up — and keep it flowing
hero.subtitle: Egypt's authorized agent for a curated set of international submersible pump & motor makers. We supply, install, and maintain complete well systems for contractors, industry, and agriculture.

servicesPage.title: Our Integrated Services
servicesPage.subtitle: We offer integrated engineering solutions in supply and maintenance of well equipment and pumping systems using state-of-the-art technologies.
servicesPage.supplyDesc: We are committed to supplying the best original equipment and products with warranty and professional installation.
servicesPage.maintenanceDesc: Integrated workshops and a mobile maintenance fleet to guarantee that your wells operate at 100% efficiency.

pump-supply.title: Supply & Installation of Pumps
pump-supply.short: Supply and installation of all types of submersible pumps and centrifugal pumps of various capacities.
pump-supply.desc: We provide supply and installation services for Submersible Pumps and vertical/horizontal centrifugal pumps from major international brands. Our engineering team studies the water well to determine precise requirements for production rate, height, and selects the most appropriate pump to ensure maximum operational efficiency and lowest energy consumption.

panel-design.title: Design & Supply of Electrical Control Panels
panel-design.short: Design and supply of smart electrical control and protection panels to safeguard motors and pumps.
panel-design.desc: We design and assemble electrical control panels (Control Panels) of various capacities and operating systems (Star-Delta, Soft Starter, Inverter). We use the highest quality global electrical components to ensure full protection for pumps and motors against phase loss, overcurrent, or under-voltage.

regulator-design.title: Design & Supply of Voltage Regulators
regulator-design.short: Voltage stabilization and regulation systems to protect industrial facilities and well stations.
regulator-design.desc: We excel in designing and supplying high-capacity voltage regulators (Stabilizers) to protect sensitive equipment and well motors from voltage fluctuations in remote and industrial areas, extending the lifetime of pumps and ensuring full operational stability.

inverter-supply.title: Supply of Inverters & Variable Frequency Drives
inverter-supply.short: VFDs for precise water flow control, energy saving, and solar power operations.
inverter-supply.desc: We supply and program variable speed drives (Inverters / VFDs) that allow smart and smooth control of motor speed and water flow. We also provide eco-friendly solar-powered pump operation solutions, which ensure excellent economical operation for agricultural irrigation stations and wells.

marine-cable-supply.title: Supply of Marine/Submersible Cables
marine-cable-supply.short: High-quality insulated submersible cables resistant to water and pressure in deep wells.
marine-cable-supply.desc: We provide fully insulated submersible/marine cables made of materials resistant to water, high pressure, and heat, specifically designed for heavy-duty work in deep wells. Our cables ensure efficient power transmission without voltage drop and complete safety against electrical leakage.

well-pipe-supply.title: Supply of Deep Well Pipes
well-pipe-supply.short: Iron and reinforced plastic (uPVC) pipes customized for wells to resist corrosion and high pressure.
well-pipe-supply.desc: Supply of metal well pipes and reinforced plastic pipes (uPVC) customized for submersible wells. Our products are highly resistant to corrosion, rust, soil pressure, and tension, ensuring smooth water flow and the integrity of the well structure for decades.

pump-maintenance.title: Pumps Maintenance
pump-maintenance.short: Rehabilitation and maintenance of submersible and horizontal pumps and changing genuine spare parts.
pump-maintenance.desc: We offer comprehensive maintenance and repair services for all types of submersible and surface pumps. Our services include technical inspection, pressure and flow tests, machining of damaged parts, and replacing bearings and mechanical seals with genuine spare parts to restore factory efficiency.

motor-maintenance.title: Motors Maintenance
motor-maintenance.short: Rewinding of submersible and surface electric motors and heat insulation treatment.
motor-maintenance.desc: Fully equipped workshops for rewinding and maintaining electric motors (low and medium voltage). We use high-quality copper wires and highly durable, heat-resistant insulation materials, and run insulation and dynamic balance tests to ensure stable performance and longer motor life.

panel-maintenance.title: Electrical Control Panels Maintenance
panel-maintenance.short: Troubleshooting, upgrading control systems, and replacing damaged electrical components.
panel-maintenance.desc: Our engineers and technicians inspect and maintain electrical control panels, diagnose faults, program protection devices and inverters, and replace damaged breakers and contactors to ensure continuous, automatic, and safe station operation.

regulator-maintenance.title: Voltage Regulators Maintenance
regulator-maintenance.short: Inspection and maintenance of voltage stabilization devices and replacing transformers and circuits.
regulator-maintenance.desc: Specialized maintenance service for voltage regulators and stabilizers of various sizes and industrial capacities, including replacing electronic cards and copper coils and calibrating measuring instruments to ensure precise, continuous voltage regulation.

productsPage.title: Products Showcase
productsPage.subtitle: We provide a wide range of high-quality, reliable industrial equipment and machinery for agriculture, water, and construction sectors.

motor-hitemp.title: HI-TEMP Submersible Motors
motor-hitemp.desc: Genuine Kurlar KM HI-TEMP submersible motors (6"-10"), rewindable and rated for continuous operation up to 90°C. High-temperature PBN winding wire, water-cooled construction, and a stainless steel shaft deliver a longer service life and lower operating cost than standard motors, manufactured in ISO 9001 certified facilities.

pump-submersible.title: Deep Well Submersible Pumps
pump-submersible.desc: Genuine Kurlar KP/KPS stainless steel submersible pumps. Their corrosion-resistant AISI 304 construction delivers long service life and reliable performance for demanding agricultural irrigation, industrial water supply, and groundwater dewatering applications.

pump-cast-stainless.title: Cast Stainless Submersible Pumps
pump-cast-stainless.desc: Genuine Kurlar KSX cast stainless steel submersible pumps (6"-8"-10"). All wetted parts — diffusers, impellers, and suction/discharge chambers — are cast in AISI 304 stainless steel for outstanding corrosion resistance, high efficiency, and long service life. Suitable for both horizontal and vertical installation; full AISI 316L construction available on request.

elec-inverter.title: Solar & Well Variable Frequency Inverter
elec-inverter.desc: An advanced, high-efficiency solar-driven pump controller with Dynamic MPPT technology, delivering stable performance, intelligent power management, and long-life reliability for agricultural, industrial, and off-grid water pumping applications. Supports solar-only or hybrid solar + grid operation with automatic switching.

pipe-upvc-column.title: uPVC Column Pipes
pipe-upvc-column.desc: Genuine Astral Bore-Well lead-free column pipes for submersible pumps. Manufactured with square-thread couplers, EPDM 'O' Ring seals, and a double stainless steel stud pin locking system, they are 100% free of lead and heavy metals, UV-stabilised, and rigorously tested for leak-proof, long-lasting performance in deep well and borehole installations.

thrust-bearing-heavy.title: Heavy Duty Thrust Bearings
thrust-bearing-heavy.desc: Genuine Alka AP+ Series silicon carbide (SiC) ceramic thrust bearings, engineered for challenging deep-well applications where sand, ferrous debris, or high thrust loads exceed the capacity of conventional bearings. Retaining full strength at temperatures up to 1100°C and validated through in-house and field testing, they deliver outstanding wear resistance and reliability where standard stainless steel or carbon bearings fail.

cable-submersible.title: Submersible Motor Cables
cable-submersible.desc: Water-resistant, copper-conductor cables designed to safely power submersible motors in deep well installations.

cable-flat-untel.title: PVC Flat Power & Control Cable
cable-flat-untel.desc: Genuine Üntel H07VVH6-F PVC flat power and control cable, rated 450/750V, used for power and control wiring inside pump control panels, starter cabinets, and deep well pump stations. IPX8 tested by TÜV for permanent submersion up to 10 bar (100 m), UV resistant, and flame retardant.

agentsPage.title: Our Agents & Partners
agentsPage.subtitle: El Waha is the authorized agent and distributor for prominent international brands in Egypt, ensuring you get 100% genuine products with warranty.

astral-pipes.name: Astral Pipes
astral-pipes.title: uPVC Column & Well Casing Pipes
astral-pipes.desc: A global Indian leader in the production of high-tensile uPVC column pipes and casing pipes for water wells. Known for high load capacity, easy installation, and leak-proof joints.

jee-pumps.name: JEE Pumps
jee-pumps.title: Industrial & Submersible Pumps
jee-pumps.desc: One of the largest manufacturers of submersible and centrifugal pumps of various capacities for industrial, agricultural, and municipal applications, characterized by superior hydraulic efficiency.

pmc.name: PMC
pmc.title: Electrical Control Components & Panels
pmc.desc: An international brand specializing in manufacturing electrical control panel components, transformers, and highly reliable stabilizers designed for harsh industrial conditions.

kurlar.name: Kurlar
kurlar.title: Heavy-Duty Submersible Motors
kurlar.desc: A prominent brand producing stainless steel and cast iron submersible motors with excellent thermal insulation and heat resistance to guarantee long-term operation.

alka.name: ALKA Thrust Bearing
alka.title: Submersible Motor Thrust Bearings
alka.desc: The leading manufacturer and supplier of high-quality thrust bearings for submersible motors, ensuring reduced friction and absorption of vertical mechanical loads in deep wells.

eventsPage.title: Events & Exhibitions
eventsPage.subtitle: Follow El Waha's participation in industry exhibitions and trade shows across Egypt.

sahara-2025.title: Sahara Expo 2025
sahara-2025.desc: El Waha for Wells and Pump Services took part in Sahara Expo 2025 alongside major companies in the agricultural sector. We showcased our full range of submersible pumps, motors, control panels, and well piping from Kurlar, Tormac, Astral Pipes, PMC, and NOVO, and welcomed clients and partners from across the industry to our stand.

aboutPage.title: El Waha Pumps Company
aboutPage.subtitle: 20+ Years of Excellence and Leadership Serving Our Clients in Egypt
aboutPage.p1: El Waha for Well Services and Pumps was established to be the trusted partner and integrated engineering solution provider in Egypt's water and well sector. For over 20 years, we have successfully executed hundreds of agricultural, industrial, and municipal projects with utmost professionalism.
aboutPage.p2: We specialize in drilling deep water wells and equipping them fully, starting from supplying and installing casing and column pipes, insulated submersible cables, to supplying and installing submersible pumps and motors, and designing custom electrical control panels and stabilizers.
aboutPage.p3: El Waha stands out with its fully equipped workshops featuring the latest testing, calibration, and rewinding machinery, alongside a mobile maintenance fleet ready for immediate 24/7 intervention to support our clients across all Egyptian governorates.
aboutPage.visionText: To be the leading and preferred company in Egypt and Africa for sustainable, smart water pumping solutions and water infrastructure development, with engineering excellence and uncompromised quality.
aboutPage.missionText: To deliver original high-quality products and design innovative engineering solutions that guarantee sustainable water flow, reduce energy consumption, and provide superior ongoing maintenance services.
